payload.claim: The module docstring still asserts 'ten frozen dataclasses' and 'Event union naming all ten' (also line 13: 'ten kinds are sufficient', and comments at lines 799 and 876), but this change adds an eleventh kind (TaskOutcome) — _KINDS now has 11 entries and the Event union has 11 members. The spec's own notes explicitly called for rewriting every stale count claim in this file once the eleventh kind landed, but only the FINDINGS-count sentence (lines 15-16) was updated; the docstring's core 'ten kinds are sufficient' claim, which this file uses as its own self-proof of completeness, is now false and no gate checks prose for numeric accuracy.
